_doc: Signals for the cross-function / boundary invariant lens. Two-signal, FP-tight: the lens flags CANDIDATE writer/reader pairs whose cross-function invariant cannot be confirmed by a local clear, and routes them to needs_deep_pass. It never asserts a definite bug. Derived from Recall miss classes H-03/H-04/H-06.

store_key_vs_read_key_divergence.description: A value is keyed/hashed with one representation in the writer but looked up/verified with a different one in the reader (e.g. toHash vs toTracingId), so a stored entry can never be found.

counter_limit_divergence.description: A counter/length is incremented in one function but its bound is enforced (or not) elsewhere with a different limit/width, so the count can exceed the downstream limit or become inconsistent.

written_consumed_assumption_gap.description: State validated/written under one function's assumptions is consumed by another function without the equivalent validation.

queue_key_length_bound_divergence.description: Queue append/read/drop paths use different keys, lengths, or bounds, so entries can be skipped or stranded.

cross_function_reentrancy.description: A nonReentrant function makes an external/native call whose post-call state is consumed by a sibling, non-guarded function — the per-function guard does not cover the cross-function transition.
